answer: The violet register is checked at draw time, zenith lists the eligible set, and river seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 69 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 69 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Honest users pay that once, farms 26 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
